what were the top 5 products by revenue.sql: SELECT stock_code, max(description) AS description, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE is_product = TRUE AND line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY net_revenue_gbp DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: Revenue means net revenue (sales minus returns) according to data rules.
Products are filtered by is_product = TRUE.
Money is rounded to 2 decimal places.
what were the top 5 products by revenue.title: Top 5 Products by Net Revenue

what was our revenue excluding cancelled.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS gross_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type = 'sale'
assumptions: Revenue excluding cancelled invoices refers to gross revenue (Rule 3).
what was our revenue excluding cancelled.title: Gross Revenue (Excluding Cancelled Invoices)

show monthly net revenue in 2011.sql: SELECT strftime(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') AND invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
assumptions: Net revenue is defined as sales minus returns (line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation')).
Year 2011 is defined as invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' and invoice_date < '2012-01-01'.
Money is in GBP and rounded to 2 decimal places.
show monthly net revenue in 2011.title: Monthly Net Revenue in 2011

which country generated the highest net.sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') GROUP BY country ORDER BY net_revenue_gbp DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Net revenue is calculated as the sum of line_value for both sales and cancellations (Data Rule 4).
which country generated the highest net.title: Country with Highest Net Revenue

how many invoices were cancelled.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS cancelled_invoice_count FROM transactions WHERE is_cancelled = TRUE
assumptions: Cancelled invoices are identified by having is_cancelled = TRUE (invoice number starts with 'C').
how many invoices were cancelled.title: Total Cancelled Invoices

what was our net sales revenue in 2011.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_sales_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') AND invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01'
assumptions: Net revenue includes sales and returns (cancellations) for the calendar year 2011 (half-open range from 2011-01-01 to 2012-01-01).
what was our net sales revenue in 2011.title: Net Sales Revenue for 2011

which products were returned most last q.sql: SELECT stock_code, max(description) AS description, SUM(-quantity) AS returned_units FROM transactions WHERE line_type = 'cancellation' AND is_product = TRUE AND invoice_date >= '2011-07-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-10-01' GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY returned_units DESC LIMIT 10
assumptions: Last quarter refers to the last complete calendar quarter of the dataset, Q3 2011 (2011-07-01 to 2011-10-01).
Returned most is measured by total units returned (SUM(-quantity)), per Data Rule 2.
Only valid products (is_product = TRUE) are included, per Data Rule 7.
which products were returned most last q.title: Top Products Returned by Units in Q3 2011
